faqPage.metaDescription: All the frequently asked questions and answers about Siriplan. Booking, pricing, technical support, and more.
faqPage.heroSubtitle: If you can't find what you're looking for, reach us via WhatsApp or email.

q1.a: Siriplan is an AI-powered appointment and business management platform built for hair salons, barbershops, beauty salons, spas, clinics, and more. It's developed by BY Sirius Group Ai & Technology Co Ltd.

q2.a: We offer tailored solutions for 10+ industries, including hair salons, barbershops, beauty salons, spa & massage, nail salons, aesthetic clinics, makeup studios, tattoo studios, dietitians, and brow & lash studios.

q3.q: Can I use the app in English?
q3.a: Yes. The platform supports Turkish, English, Russian, and Arabic. You can change your language preference in settings.

q4.a: Yes. You can manage unlimited locations on the Business plan. Starter and Pro plans have an extra-location add-on option.

q1.a: Yes, no credit card information is required. You can use all Pro plan features free for 14 days.

q2.a: Prices are in USD. Payment is processed securely via Stripe. Please contact us for payment in Turkish lira.

q3.a: Yes, you can cancel anytime with no commitment or penalty. Even after cancelling, you keep access to and can download your data for 30 days.

q4.q: How much do I save with the annual plan?
q4.a: An 18% discount applies with annual billing. For example, the Pro plan is $52/mo (billed $620/yr) instead of $63/mo.

q1.a: They can book 24/7 via the website, WhatsApp, Instagram DM, and QR code. Conflict checking is automatic.

q2.q: How does the WhatsApp reminder work?
q2.a: A WhatsApp message is sent to the customer at set times before the appointment (e.g. 24 hours, 2 hours before). It reduces your no-show rate by up to 60%.

q3.q: What does the customer score system do?
q3.a: Every customer is assigned a score from 0-100 based on visit frequency, spending, and loyalty. You can recognize your valuable customers and offer them priority booking and special deals.

q4.a: Yes, the waiting list feature is available. Add customers to the queue when slots are full, notify them with one click, and convert them to appointments.

q1.q: What does the AI assistant do?
q1.a: It reads WhatsApp and Instagram DMs 24/7, answers pricing and booking questions, and books appointments on the customer's behalf. Your business keeps running while you sleep.

q2.q: Can the AI assistant give wrong information?
q2.a: The AI assistant only answers based on the services, prices, and availability you've defined. It routes questions beyond that to "Please contact us directly."

q3.q: How does the campaign module work?
q3.a: Build a customer list based on specific criteria (haven't visited in 3 months, upcoming birthdays, etc.) and send bulk WhatsApp/SMS/email messages.

q1.q: Can I move my data to another system?
q1.a: Yes. You can download all your data in JSON, Excel, or CSV format anytime. You're never locked into any platform.

q2.q: Can I import data from my current system?
q2.a: Yes. One-click data import from your current booking software or Excel is supported. With our Professional Data Migration service, our team can do it for you.

q3.a: Yes. Customer data is stored in compliance with KVKK regulations, end-to-end encryption is applied, and data can be processed on servers in Turkey.

q4.a: We target 99.9% uptime on BY Sirius Group infrastructure. Planned maintenance is announced in advance and usually takes place at night.

mic.introBody: To book appointments by voice, your browser needs access to the microphone. Audio is captured only while you speak and is never stored.
mic.introHint: When you tap "Continue", your browser will ask for permission — choose "Allow" in that prompt.
mic.blockedBody: Your browser is blocking the microphone for this site. Follow the steps below and try again.

nativeApp: Phone Settings → Apps → Siriplan → Permissions → Microphone → Allow.
If "Microphone" isn't in the list, this build of the app doesn't support audio capture — use voice booking in a browser (Chrome/Safari) on siriplan.com instead.
After granting it, return to the app and tap "Try again".
desktop: Click the lock or settings icon on the left of the address bar.
Reload the page and press "Try again".
android: Tap the lock icon in the address bar → "Permissions" → "Microphone" → Allow.
If that doesn't work: Phone Settings → Apps → your browser → Permissions → Microphone → Allow.
Return to this page and tap "Try again".
ios: Open iPhone Settings → scroll down and pick your browser (Safari or Chrome).
Return to this page and tap "Try again".

mic.desktopSettingsHint: As soon as you change the permission, this window continues on its own.

mic.notUnderstood: Couldn't understand that. Please try again.
mic.analyzeFailed: Voice analysis failed. Please try again.
mic.missingHint: The highlighted fields are still missing — add them by voice or fill them in manually.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.subtitle: Manage your salon profile and app preferences.
settingsPage.legalSectionDesc: All copyright and intellectual property rights to this software are registered by BY Sirius Group Ai & Technology Co Ltd. and protected under the Berne Convention and FSEK provisions.
settingsPage.accountDeletionDesc: In compliance with mobile application store policies (App Store & Play Store) and data privacy regulations, you can permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
settingsPage.billingCardDesc: Plan, usage limits and payment management
settingsPage.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP — up to 2MB. Shown on your booking page.
settingsPage.taxNumberPlaceholder: Tax No (10 digits) or National ID (11 digits)
settingsPage.timezoneHint: Working hours, availability and appointment notifications are calculated based on this time zone.
settingsPage.locationHint: Find your business on Google Maps, copy the link via Share and paste it here — the automatic appointment confirmation messages show customers the correct location they can reach by tapping this link. If left blank, a map link is generated automatically from your address.
settingsPage.bookingLinkDesc: Share this link in your social media bio or with customers via WhatsApp. Customers can see open slots and book themselves; they are automatically added to your customer list along with the privacy notice they accept.
settingsPage.qrShareHint: You can print and display it in your salon; customers can scan it with their phone to reach your booking page directly.
settingsPage.websiteUpsellTitle: Turn your booking page into a website →
settingsPage.websiteUpsellDesc: A sales-boosting business page with a color palette, cover photo, service categories and photos — on your existing booking link, with no extra address.
settingsPage.bookingLinkFailed: Your booking link could not be created, please contact the support team.
settingsPage.socialIconHint: If website mode is on, it appears as an icon on your booking page.
settingsPage.telegramHint: When a new appointment is created (online or manually), an instant Telegram notification is sent here.
settingsPage.telegramHelpSummary: How do I find my Chat ID?
settingsPage.telegramStep1: Find our notification bot on Telegram and press Start.
settingsPage.telegramStep2: The bot will send you a Chat ID number.
settingsPage.telegramStep3: Paste that number above and save — you'll now get a notification for every appointment.
settingsPage.autoMessageDesc: These are the texts you send manually from your own WhatsApp when the 'Send WhatsApp message to customer' box is checked on the appointment screens (New Appointment / Quick Appointment) and via the 'Send Manual Message' button in appointment details. Date and time are filled in automatically for each appointment.
settingsPage.autoMessageWarning: This channel is NOT connected to Meta — the message opens in the WhatsApp on your own phone and you send it, so you can edit the text however you like. It is a different channel from the Meta automatic messages in the "WhatsApp Notification Settings" section below — if both are on, the customer may receive the same information twice, so keeping one off is recommended. If you turn Meta automatic messages off entirely, this manual channel becomes your only notification method.
settingsPage.presetSicakText: Dear {musteri}, your appointment at {salon} on {tarih} at {saat} has been created. If you have any questions, you can reach us at this number. See you soon! 💫
settingsPage.presetResmiText: Dear {musteri}, your appointment at {salon} on {tarih} at {saat} has been recorded. For your information.
settingsPage.presetHizmetliText: Hi {musteri}, your {hizmet} appointment on {tarih} {saat} with {personel} at {salon} has been created. We're expecting you!
settingsPage.onlineBookingDesc: Appointments from your online booking page (/r/...) are auto-confirmed by default and added to the calendar.
settingsPage.autoConfirmDesc: When on, appointments from the online page are confirmed immediately and added to the calendar. When off, appointments are held in a "pending" queue until you approve them (the manual approval queue is exclusive to the Pro/Business plan).
settingsPage.autoConfirmFreeText: Your online appointments are auto-confirmed and added to the calendar. Holding appointments for approval first (manual approval queue) is exclusive to the Pro/Business plan.
settingsPage.slotIntervalDesc: The time intervals visitors see when choosing an appointment (15 minutes, 30 minutes or hourly).
settingsPage.currencyDesc: The currency used in the inventory, income & expenses, payroll and commission screens (if you have customers paying abroad or in foreign currency).
settingsPage.whatsappNotifDesc: A custom note appended to the reminder and cancellation messages sent automatically as the appointment time approaches.
settingsPage.autoWhatsappReminderDesc: If you turn this off, automatic reminder messages for the duration selected below are not sent.
settingsPage.metaEventsLabel: For which events should an automatic WhatsApp message be sent via Meta?
settingsPage.metaEventsDesc: These messages are sent automatically from Sirius's shared WhatsApp Business number using a Meta-approved template. If you turn an event off, no automatic message is sent for it — you can send it manually from your own WhatsApp using the "Send WhatsApp message to customer" box on the appointment screen. Don't keep both on, or the customer will receive the same information twice.
settingsPage.reminderOffsetLabel: How many hours before the appointment should the reminder be sent?
settingsPage.reminderOffsetDesc: You can select only one duration — selecting one disables the others.
settingsPage.metaTemplatesDesc: From the approved template variants registered in your Meta WhatsApp Business panel, choose the one that applies for each case.
settingsPage.metaTemplatesFootnote: The text of these templates is pre-approved in your Meta WhatsApp Business panel, so it can't be edited here — you can only choose which variant is used. The previews above are an approximate example of the parameters that will be sent (name, date, time, etc.); the exact text depends on the approved template in your Meta panel.
settingsPage.smsNotifDesc: You can also send appointment confirmation, reminder and cancellation notifications by SMS. To do so, open an account with an SMS provider (Netgsm, VatanSMS or İletimerkezi) and enter your API details here.
settingsPage.smsEnabledDesc: When off, the "Send SMS" buttons in appointment details don't work.
settingsPage.smsSenderHint: The header you had approved by the operator from your provider panel — SMS is rejected if sent without approval.
settingsPage.smsCostText: Roughly 0.08–0.20 TRY per SMS (depending on package size) — you need to buy a credit package from the provider's site; there is no fixed monthly fee.
settingsPage.waBusinessConnDesc: Appointment confirmation/reminder/cancellation messages are sent automatically from Siriplan's own WhatsApp line — you don't need to do anything for that. The connection below is only so that marketing messages sent from the Campaigns module and automatic replies to incoming messages go from your own WhatsApp Business number.
settingsPage.waHowToText: Connect a WhatsApp Business account via Meta Business Suite, then copy the permanent access token and phone number ID from Meta for Developers > your app > WhatsApp > API Setup. While these fields are empty, your campaigns can't be sent over the WhatsApp channel (you can use the SMS channel).
settingsPage.kdvDesc: Enter your rate to see the estimated VAT amount in Income & Expense reports. The income amounts you enter are assumed to include VAT.
settingsPage.kdvEnabledDesc: When on, the estimated VAT amount is shown on the Income & Expense page.
settingsPage.kdvRateHint: The standard rate in Türkiye is 20%.
settingsPage.kvkkDesc: The privacy notice shown to your customers when they book. If left blank, the platform's default text is used.
settingsPage.workingHoursDesc: Leave the open/close times blank for closed days
settingsPage.legalBody: All source code, designs, and flows of the Siriplan platform are protected under FSEK and the Berne Convention. A fully compliant infrastructure with Store (App Store / Play Store) policies and GDPR/KVKK data privacy is provided.
settingsPage.dangerZoneBody: When you delete your account, your login credentials and all staff access of your business will be permanently closed, and your subscription will be cancelled. Your customer records will not be deleted, but personal identifying details (name, phone, email) will be anonymized; appointment and revenue history will continue to be kept statistically for the legal accounting retention period. This action cannot be undone.
